name: Visual Design Studio
description: AI visual design chain: interpret a vague brief into a design spec (purpose, platform size, style anchor), engineer text-to-image prompts with model dialects and text-rendering rules, and audit output against platform layout specs (safe areas, ratios, text budgets). One brief flows through spec -> prompt -> audit without leaving the chain.
description_zh: AI 视觉设计链条：把模糊需求翻译成设计规格单（用途/平台尺寸/风格锚），按模型方言与文字渲染规则写文生图 prompt，并按平台版面规格（比例/安全区/文字预算）审计产出。一条需求从规格到 prompt 到审计全程不出链。方法论借鉴 Anthropic canvas-design / designskills / Replicate prompting 指南并已署名。
